editorial:
Imagine a delivery guy who spends his free time racing motorcycles, only to discover he is the reincarnation of a powerful mythological hero. That is the wild ride you get here. The story drops you into a stylish world where old gods and modern life collide, and Nezha has to face enemies from his past life while trying to protect the people he cares about now. The vibe is high-energy and flashy, mixing steampunk cityscapes with epic fantasy battles, and it never slows down for long.

The animation is gorgeous, with smooth action scenes and creative fight choreography that keeps you on the edge of your seat. The pacing is fast, though newcomers to Chinese mythology might feel a little lost at first. Still, the emotional core about family and sacrifice lands well. If you enjoy anime-style action or myth retellings, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: In the final act, Nezha fully accepts his identity and unlocks his true powers. He confronts his old enemies in a massive battle, protecting his friends and family from destruction. The twist reveals that his loved ones were always meant to be part of his journey, and by embracing both his past and present, he defeats the villains and secures peace for the city. The story ends with Nezha choosing to live as both hero and ordinary guy.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves anime-style action and myth retellings.
